snippet.title: Spit Wad Willy (Dos game 1993)
snippet.description:
Spit Wad Willy is a fixed action game programmed by Raoul Said.
It's a clone of Pang (パン Pomping World).
Shoot and destroy all the bouncing balls.
Six useful items help you.
